parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-06 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 857.1 | 0.64 | 0.64
2 | 996.7 | 0.52 | 1.16
3 | 83.1 | 1.53 | 2.69
4 | 335.1 | 3.03 | 5.72
5 | 27.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-06
Curve type: Complex
Aquifer depth: 2.69 - 5.72 m
Recommendation: Target the high-resistivity layer between 2.69 m and 5.72 m for potential water production. Ensure proper casing is used to stabilize the borehole through the surrounding clay-rich layers.
